# notation -> Turtle (hop 1) -> notation -> Turtle (hop 2), then the two
# Turtle graphs compared as triple sets. Verdicts: stable (hop 2 is
# byte-identical), whitespace-only (bytes differ, triple sets equal once the
# whitespace inside sysx:sourceText literals is normalised), graph-diff,
# unwritable (Turtle -> notation refused), unparseable (the written notation
# no longer converts) and refused:<class> (notation -> Turtle refused). This
# is a per-file ratchet, not a claim that any verdict is right; see
